/day. As a swift action, you choose one target within sight to smite. If this target is chaotic, you add +

to all damage rolls made against it, and automatically bypass any DR the creature might possess. This ability is twice as effective against outsiders with the chaotic subtype, chaotic-aligned aberrations, and fey. In addition, you gain a +
